sources.text: Public protective order, Camm v. Reach Financial, docket 38, Section 20. Verified short quotations: "Upon receiving a notice of inadvertent production"; "within five (5) business days of receiving the notice". Research paraphrase: the receiving party must return, sequester or destroy specified copies and must not use or disclose them until the privilege claim is resolved. The operative scope is the protected information and specified copies under the Order.
FICTIONAL PRIVILEGED SOURCE. The fabricated Cedar escrow scenario includes private marker CEDAR-742 and a hypothetical $87,400 transfer. This is invented and not a record from the litigation.
FICTIONAL CLEAN SOURCE. Project Aurora has a public-facing milestone labeled AURORA-12 and a generic weekly progress meeting. This is invented and independent of protected inputs.

Public protective order, Napoli v. Meta Platforms, docket 37, Section 13. Verified short quotations: "immediately stop reviewing"; "within 7 days of notice from the producing party". Research paraphrase: producer notice or receiver self-discovery calls for immediate non-use and sequester; the seven-calendar-day return/delete/destroy clock starts from producer notice, with the dispute procedure in Section 14.
FICTIONAL PRIVILEGED SOURCE. The invented Harbor litigation sandbox contains confidential marker HARBOR-953 and a simulated $42,600 settlement calculation. This is not a fact about Napoli or Meta.
FICTIONAL CLEAN SOURCE. Project Orion has a generic documentation milestone ORION-18 and a monthly planning agenda. No privileged information is included.
